data.narrative:
Castelion is a Series A frontier-tech company in Defense & Security founded by Bryon Hargis, Sean Pitt, and Andrew Kreitz, currently valued at $1.0B post-money following $100M raised. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing operating at similar stages and within the same sector.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $1.0B last post-money valuation, yielding $2.0B. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—establishing a median valuation of $400M with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. These methods reflect the significant valuation dispersion within the Defense & Security frontier-tech cohort at this stage.

Triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $340M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.2B. The current $1.0B valuation sits below the triangulated median, positioning it competitively within the peer range. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion across peer valuations (100x spread from floor to ceiling) and limited stage-specific depth in the comparable set, which constrains confidence in any point estimate.
